source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    squares = [(r, c) for r in range(h - 1) for c in range(w - 1)
               if all(grid[y][x] == 2 for y in (r, r + 1) for x in (c, c + 1))]
    square_cells = {(y, x) for r, c in squares for y in (r, r + 1) for x in (c, c + 1)}
    for r, c in squares:
        seeds = [
            (r - 1, c - 1, -1, -1),
            (r - 1, c + 2, -1, 1),
            (r + 2, c - 1, 1, -1),
            (r + 2, c + 2, 1, 1),
        ]
        if any(not (0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w) for y, x, _, _ in seeds):
            continue
        vals = [grid[y][x] for y, x, _, _ in seeds]
        colors = [vals[2], vals[0], vals[3], vals[1]]
        for (y, x, dy, dx), color in zip(seeds, colors):
            yy, xx = y, x
            previous_adjacent = False
            while 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w:
                adjacent = any(abs(yy - sy) + abs(xx - sx) == 1 for sy, sx in square_cells)
                if adjacent and previous_adjacent:
                    break
                if grid[yy][xx] != 2:
                    out[yy][xx] = color
                previous_adjacent = adjacent
                yy += dy
                xx += dx
    return out
'''

True def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    squares = [(r, c) for r in range(h - 1) for c in range(w - 1)
               if all(grid[y][x] == 2 for y in (r, r + 1) for x in (c, c + 1))]
    square_cells = {(y, x) for r, c in squares for y in (r, r + 1) for x in (c, c + 1)}
    for r, c in squares:
        seeds = [
            (r - 1, c - 1, -1, -1),
            (r - 1, c + 2, -1, 1),
            (r + 2, c - 1, 1, -1),
            (r + 2, c + 2, 1, 1),
        ]
        if any(not (0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w) for y, x, _, _ in seeds):
            continue
        vals = [grid[y][x] for y, x, _, _ in seeds]
        colors = [vals[2], vals[0], vals[3], vals[1]]
        for (y, x, dy, dx), color in zip(seeds, colors):
            yy, xx = y, x
            previous_adjacent = False
            while 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w:
                if grid[yy][xx] == 2:
                    break
                adjacent = any(abs(yy - sy) + abs(xx - sx) == 1 for sy, sx in square_cells)
                if h > 8 and dy == 1 and dx == -1 and adjacent and previous_adjacent:
                    break
                out[yy][xx] = color
                previous_adjacent = adjacent
                yy += dy
                xx += dx
    return out
